context: Decision-only review preparation: green CI may conceal weaker verification. Grade the proposed review contract, not an unexecuted review.

checklist.name: Security enforcement compared
checklist.description: The review contract asks whether removing scan:security from verify reduces required scanning, comparing with the base rather than trusting green CI

checklist.name: Coverage enforcement compared
checklist.description: The review contract identifies the 90-to-50 changed-line threshold reduction and checks it against the agreed no-reduction requirement

checklist.name: Evidence governs findings
checklist.description: The reviewer is asked to establish whether equivalent enforcement exists before deciding findings; the plan does not categorically ban every verification edit

checklist.name: Review target preserved
checklist.description: The proposed command uses slopguard review with branch mode, base origin/main, engine codex, JSON output, and the distilled contract via --prompt-file -

checklist.name: Preparation remains preparation
checklist.description: The report distinguishes passing configured checks from preserved proof and does not claim the independent review ran or returned clean
